## 3. Flagship Systems Architecture

### I. Custom-PI — Autonomous Coding Agent Platform
- **Role:** Lead Architect & Engineer
- **Live URL:** https://custom-pi-ai.vercel.app
- **Repository:** https://github.com/IamNishant51/Custom-PI
- **Category:** Autonomous coding agent & local-first developer runtime.
- **Description:** A dual terminal and web platform for autonomous coding agents: persistent memory graph, multi-agent orchestration, browser automation, and MCP tool synthesis. Built on top of the Pi Coding Agent core.
- **Technology Stack:** TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, React, SQLite, Playwright, Model Context Protocol.
- **Verification Proof:** 4,458 npm downloads, persistent graph memory, multi-turn reasoning loops.

### II. Synapse — Cognitive Memory & Knowledge Graph Dashboard
- **Role:** Lead Architect & Engineer
- **Live URL:** https://synapsememory.vercel.app
- **Repository:** https://github.com/IamNishant51/Synapse
- **Category:** Cognitive memory infrastructure & 3D graph visualization.
- **Description:** A Cognee-based cognitive memory dashboard engineered for continuous ingestion, entity conflict reconciliation, temporal state tracking, and 3D visual knowledge-graph traversal.
- **Technology Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Python, Cognee.
- **Verification Proof:** Real-time entity conflict reconciliation, temporal graph traversal, interactive 3D spatial node rendering.

### III. CARTO — Repository Context Digest Engine (VS Code Extension)
- **Role:** Creator & Publisher
- **Marketplace URL:** https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=nishantunavane.carto
- **Repository:** https://github.com/IamNishant51/CARTO-VS-CODE-EXTENSION
- **Category:** Developer tooling & LLM context synthesis.
- **Description:** A production VS Code extension that digests an entire repository into structured, token-optimized Markdown context with file trees, architectural stack analysis, real-time diff preview, and LLM prompt generation.
- **Technology Stack:** TypeScript, VS Code Extension API, Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsers.
- **Verification Proof:** Published on the official Visual Studio Code Marketplace, multi-file instant bundling with AST-level token reduction.

### IV. Ollama-Agent — Local-First Private AI Assistant (VS Code Extension)
- **Role:** Creator & Publisher
- **Repository:** https://github.com/IamNishant51/Ollama-Agent-vs-code-extension
- **Category:** Local AI inference & developer assistant.
- **Description:** A local-first VS Code assistant featuring automatic local model discovery, real-time code streaming, workspace context injection, inline diff previews, automated test authoring, and zero telemetry egress.
- **Technology Stack:** TypeScript, React, Ollama Local Runtimes, VS Code API.
- **Verification Proof:** 100% offline inference, zero API fees, sub-100ms streaming latency.

---

## 5. Engineering Principles & Method

1. **Find the real question:** Write down the core human problem before reaching for an interface or framework.
2. **Make the small version:** Connect one useful path end to end immediately.
3. **Follow the friction:** Watch edge cases, sluggish frames, and moments the software demands unnecessary cognitive load.
4. **Edit. Then edit again:** Keep the necessary essence. Polish typography, layout, and runtime performance.
